title: Migrate TaskFlow Lite to TypeScript
goal: Move the working JavaScript TaskFlow Lite into TypeScript without hiding the runtime boundaries.
steps: Define the smallest useful `Task` and `TaskStatus` types from actual runtime data.
Migrate functions one at a time and remove implicit `any`.
Represent loading/success/error UI state as a discriminated union.
Use `unknown` for parsed or external data and narrow before access.
Add Zod at one real runtime boundary and compare it with TypeScript-only safety.
Add an exhaustiveness check to one state switch.
Run typecheck, then intentionally create three type errors and explain each diagnostic.
evidence: A clean Git diff or file-tree change
Browser, HTTP, database, test, container, or CI evidence that proves the behavior
One deliberate failure, the evidence you used, and the root-cause fix
A short explanation of why the final responsibility lives in the chosen layer
completion: I can reproduce one key part without the walkthrough.
I can explain one trade-off I deliberately chose.
I can show one failure that my tests, constraints, or runbook now protects against.
